card.title: How much can you hold in mind?

body.question: About how many separate chunks of information can young adults hold in working memory at once?
body.reveal: Research since 2001 suggests about four chunks, not the 'seven plus or minus two' from the famous 1956 paper.

probes.question: About how many chunks can young adults hold in working memory at once?

sources.title: The Magical Number Seven, Plus or Minus Two (Wikipedia)

image_brief.show: An abstract illustration of memory, or a phone keypad

claims.claim: About four chunks can be held in working memory by young adults.
claims.quote: Cowan proposed that working memory has a capacity of about four chunks in young adults

claims.claim: The famous 'seven plus or minus two' paper dates from 1956.

claims.quote: Cowan, Nelson (2001). "The magical number 4 in short-term memory

claims.claim: Probe: young adults hold about 4 chunks (estimate).
